5up_ra: By the time Yann Upra reached R-C6, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-C6. Yann Upra has learned to walk bent double.

Yann Upra tried to write neatly for the first line of a letter. By the third, he was writing as quickly as the thoughts arrived. The clerk counted the names twice. Yann Upra is number 653 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. From Grey Mill the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Yann Upra wrote to five brothers, all on other fronts that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'
Yann Upra (Concord) shouted a challenge across to Zeno "Lucky" Hackermt (Hegemony) at the Brickworks. The answer was lost under the guns. Nobody repeated the challenge.
Yann Upra of the Concord spotted Lucien Theramblingb of the Hegemony repairing a parapet at Grey Mill. A warning shot stopped the repair on the spot.
Yann Upra began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
Yann Upra of the Concord threw a tin of tobacco into the Hegemony trench with a note: "for the one who sings". Hugo "Mole" Kfg kept the tin.
Word of Yann Upra's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
Yann Upra offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last.
Yann finished the blanket using six kinds of cloth. The men can identify most of the donors by the patches alone.
albertljungcrantz: Arno Albertljungc signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at M-F10 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.

Arno Albertljungc tried to remember the price of a loaf in Oakmere. Three different answers seemed right, depending on how far back he thought. Arno Albertljungc got a letter with a pressed leaf from the tree by the front door at home.

The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Arno Albertljungc asked if second helpings depended on the answer. A short letter reached Arno Albertljungc: everyone is well, the dog misses you. Arno Albertljungc read the part about the dog twice.

Arno rested the rifle on a sandbag, breathed out, and squeezed. Jonas "Mole" Helwyrdo was badly wounded at the far edge of no man's land. A letter from a cousin found Arno at the supply dump. The news was bad, but Arno was glad of the news.
amberrboothby: Day 9: Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb reached R-R15 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy.
Blackwater Canal has been won. Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. Mail came up the line with a letter for Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb. Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb read it in the dugout and kept the envelope. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
In the rear quarters, Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb played football against the sappers. The ball was a sandbag stuffed with straw. The sappers cheated.
Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.
Emil "Hollow" Mitaylor and Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
The dugout has begun inventing endings to Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb's story. The cook's version involves an inheritance; the corporal's involves a disciplinary hearing.
Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb and Wendel "Spark" Nicholasbert carved a chess set out of candle wax. The kings melted too close to the stove, so the game goes on without them.
Walter "Smokes" Amberrboothb opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
The missing instalment reached Walter. The explanation was so poor that the dugout voted to keep the cook's ending.
bandit.297: Gideon Bandit introduced himself as a coal miner from Kesselby. The corporal repeated the name correctly. That helped more than the advice.
crunchymonke: Jonas Crunchymonke came up with a draft of replacements on Day 10. Nobody asked his name until the third night. After that, everyone knew it.

Jonas Crunchymonke tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog. After the loss of Grey Mill, Jonas Crunchymonke helped stack spare sandbags at P-F17. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Jonas Crunchymonke opened a parcel addressed in unfamiliar handwriting. A note inside said the usual writer had hurt a wrist. He read that note first.
Jonas Crunchymonke brushed dried mud off a letter and found one more word under it: 'soon'. He wished the rest of the sentence had survived.
Jonas Crunchymonke discovered three men claiming the next place on the leave roster. Each had a different copy of the list.
Jonas Crunchymonke came off watch and could not say whether the last hour had felt long or short. He remembered every move in one patch of wire.

Jonas Crunchymonke was on the dawn watch at P-F17 when the Hegemony raiders came. A club, a shout, and Jonas Crunchymonke was on the trench floor waiting for the medic. Raider: Roland Jester of the Hegemony (@jester.404).
Jonas Crunchymonke is fit for duty again. He celebrated by sleeping a whole afternoon before anyone noticed.
Jonas checked the leave claims against old orders. Two changes had never been copied across; one name had disappeared at a fold in the paper.
iron__from__ice_: Walter Ice was a fisherman in Northwick until the posters went up. He came to S-F7 with a pocket Bible with a hole in it, and within a day the whole bay knew that he is superstitious about the number three.
Walter Ice's transfer to the role of sniper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

Walter Ice found a clean patch on the table and put his bread on it. Someone immediately asked to borrow the patch. Day 3. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Walter Ice watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
Walter Ice had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks crossed it, Walter Ice fired. Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks was badly wounded.
The guns found S-F7. Walter Ice was dug out of a collapsed dugout with both legs pinned and carried back on a groundsheet.

Walter Ice lay on a stretcher under a canvas sheet and watched the orderlies carry men in and out. Nobody had time to talk. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Walter Ice helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
There was never a bed for Walter Ice, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F7 on his own feet.
Dawn watch. Walter Ice put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks, grazed.
Walter Ice saw the glint of an enemy scope and fired first. The man behind it, Emil Wolves, was gravely wounded.
A bullet grazed Walter Ice's ribs at S-F7. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Nils Photo of the Concord (@yoi.photo).

Walter Ice came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Walter Ice watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Walter Ice and the spotter took turns with the telescope for half a day, talking only in numbers. At the last number Walter Ice fired. Valentin Thorholting was grazed. A letter from home found Walter Ice before the night shift. Walter Ice folded it small and kept it close. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Walter Ice is number 140. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Victory at Grey Mill. Walter Ice let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.

Walter Ice fired, worked the bolt, and fired again. Across the wire, Jakub "Mole" Xman was grazed. Walter Ice ate breakfast without a word. A letter from home found Walter Ice before the night shift. Walter Ice folded it small and kept it close.

Walter Ice fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Dorian "Whistle" Csllgaks, now grazed. A letter from home found Walter Ice before the night shift. Walter Ice folded it small and kept it close.

Walter Ice read a letter saying the neighbor had married again. The whole dugout wanted the first half of the story, which was missing. A letter from home found Walter Ice before the night shift. Walter Ice folded it small and kept it close.

Someone had used a newspaper to wrap the onions. Walter Ice read a theatre review while peeling supper. A letter from home found Walter Ice before the night shift. Walter Ice folded it small and kept it close.

Walter Ice went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Pavel Wolves was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@living_with_wild_wolves) No rifles, only shovels and knives. Walter Ice dropped into the Concord trench by a dugout door and met Nils Zczc coming out. It was over in seconds. (@zczc1317) Walter Ice kept the new letter in a breast pocket all day, and touched the pocket now and then to check it was there.

Walter Ice watched the enemy lines change the guard at S-F7 every two hours, to the minute. At the next change, Dietrich Muhlhauser was badly wounded. There was a letter for Walter Ice. Someone at home had drawn a small picture in the corner. Walter Ice laughed for the first time in days.

The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Walter fired, and Henrik Youknowsomet was grazed. The runner said a letter for Walter had come up with the ammunition. Walter went to get it before the ammunition.
jamie_fxx1: After 5 days of war, S-S11 had a place for everything. On Day 6, the men rearranged a shelf to make a place for Matthias Fxx.

A one-eyed crow landed on the parapet above Matthias Fxx. The men named it the Parson and said it had chosen him. A letter from home found Matthias Fxx before the night shift. Matthias Fxx folded it small and kept it close.
Matthias Fxx stacked spare duckboards beside the junction. Within an hour, the stack had become a bench, a table and an argument.
Matthias Fxx borrowed a book with three readers already waiting in line. For once, everyone was impatient about something harmless.
the Parson the crow follows Matthias Fxx along the trench now. When the Parson flies off, men duck. They are usually right to.
News that the Hegemony had taken Blackwater Canal reached Matthias Fxx during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Matthias Fxx was hit in the hip at S-S11. Two men dragged him along the trench floor to the nearest medic. Shot by Jakub Ronne of the Concord (@ronne_02). The bearers reached Matthias Fxx at S-S11 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Jakub Ronne of the Concord (@ronne_02).

The papers say Jakub "Doc" Fxx. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Matthias Fxx's eyes. Nobody in S-S11 argues. Jakub "Doc" Fxx got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 391. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Jakub "Doc" Fxx helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
Jakub "Doc" Fxx fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Quentin "Button" Mail was grazed trying to cross it.
Somebody hung a doorbell on the next dugout. Jakub "Doc" Fxx went to look. It was a spoon tied to an empty tin.
Jakub "Doc" Fxx won a pocket watch that does not work at cards from a lance corporal in S-S11. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
Jakub "Doc" Fxx smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Hugo "Bones" Mrpickypants came out for a cup and was grazed.
Jakub "Doc" Fxx raised his head for a heartbeat too long at S-S11. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Roland Zle of the Concord (@yee.zle).
Three days with a bandage, and Jakub "Doc" Fxx is back at S-S11. He says the food at the aid post was worse than the food in the trench. Nobody believes him.
The gun crews at S-S11 and the next post fired together on a count of five. Caught between the two guns, Arno Ekwilks was badly wounded.
jared.the.jit: The sergeant gave Bastian "Bones" Jit a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 10 or any other.

A round went through the rim of Bastian "Bones" Jit's helmet and nicked his ear on the way out. He has a notch in both now. Shot by Gustav Bobopomaranc of the Hegemony (@bobopomarancza). News of the loss of Grey Mill reached P-F7 with the rations. Bastian "Bones" Jit ate while listening to the revised orders.

A bullet struck Bastian "Bones" Jit below the ribs at P-F7. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke of the Hegemony (@gardinerryker). Bastian "Bones" Jit was killed at P-F7 while passing a message along the trench. He never finished the sentence. Shot by Casimir "Button" Gardinerryke of the Hegemony (@gardinerryker).
Pavel Jit arrived carrying the family name of Bastian "Bones" Jit. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
A flare lit Saint-Ash crossroads like noon. Pavel Jit counted the seconds until darkness: eleven.
Pavel Jit began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.
The storm put out the lamp twice. On the third attempt, Pavel Jit and two others formed a very irritated windbreak.
Word of Pavel Jit's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation.
A borrowed towel came back cleaner than when Pavel Jit lent it. He is considering lending out the rest of the washing.
A bullet clipped Pavel's helmet at P-F7 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Casimir "Shadow" Bobopomaranc of the Hegemony (@bobopomarancza).
jeeves2121: Tobias Jeeves came up on Day 9 carrying news from Rosenau. A man interrupted to ask whether the railway clock had been repaired.

The Hegemony flag went up over Blackwater Canal. Tobias Jeeves did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again. A letter from home reached Tobias Jeeves before dusk. Tobias Jeeves read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Jeeves was halfway through a story when his listener fell asleep. He counted that as a success. Tobias Jeeves got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 915. The men who came later will ask about it. Grey Mill is in Hegemony hands. Tobias Jeeves watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

During a lull at Hill 304, Leopold "Whistle" Leh called across from the Concord line. Tobias Jeeves answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet. A letter from home reached Tobias Jeeves before dusk. Tobias Jeeves read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Jeeves offered to read the newspaper aloud. The audience asked for the advertisements first, then the racing results, and the war last. A letter from home reached Tobias Jeeves before dusk. Tobias Jeeves read it twice and slept a little easier.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Tobias Jeeves raised his head for a heartbeat too long at R-C15. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. A letter from home reached Tobias Jeeves before dusk. Tobias Jeeves read it twice and slept a little easier.

Stitches out, sleeve rolled down. Tobias Jeeves is whole again, or near enough for the line. A letter from home reached Tobias Jeeves before dusk. Tobias Jeeves read it twice and slept a little easier.

Tobias Jeeves threw a bomb into a Concord dugout and dived for cover. When the smoke cleared, Yann Vylet was down and screaming for a medic. (@simon_vylet) The Concord sentry, Rafael "Hollow" Red, shouted once. Tobias Jeeves silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@red05052) The letter for Tobias Jeeves had been in the rain somewhere along the way. Tobias Jeeves dried it by the stove, page by page.
Tobias Jeeves spent the afternoon delousing his shirt over a candle. The lice won on points. Tobias Jeeves read the letter, folded it, unfolded it, and read it again. The sentry pretended not to see.

Tobias got a letter from Anna. Two pages, one of them only about the weather back home. He read that page most. Tobias got a letter from the old neighbor, who wrote that Tobias's dog now sleeps at the front door every night.
kallenfultz: Day 8. The corporal put Zeno Kallenfultz beside a veteran and said to copy everything except the language.
Henrik Jns and Zeno Kallenfultz sat through a quiet hour without finding anything to say. At the change of watch, the next pair was told it had been a good hour.

A bullet grazed Zeno Kallenfultz's ribs at R-S13. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Pavel Reider of the Hegemony (@reider9921). A clear shot from R-S13. Zeno Kallenfultz badly wounded Cyril "Mole" Skies and slid back down below the parapet. The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-S13, Zeno Kallenfultz listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

A bullet went through Zeno Kallenfultz's upper arm at R-S13 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Silas Cosmicloopy of the Hegemony (@cosmicloopy). A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Zeno Kallenfultz is number 504. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Zeno Kallenfultz watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
Zeno Kallenfultz drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
The medics would not give up on Zeno Kallenfultz. On a stretcher in the open, between salvos, they kept him alive and then kept him whole. He returned to R-S13 today.
The machine gun jammed at the worst moment. Zeno Kallenfultz cleared it with a bent nail and words the chaplain pretended not to hear.
A bullet clipped Zeno Kallenfultz's helmet at R-S13 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Pavel Reider of the Hegemony (@reider9921).
The medic looked at Zeno Kallenfultz's wound, sniffed it, and sent him back to R-S13. Clean, said the medic. It is the best word a medic knows.
Zeno Kallenfultz and Henrik Jns cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button.
The cook's stew tasted of iron and smoke. Zeno ate two helpings anyway.
kibtenkibby: Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a frozen apple and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby across the shin at Q-F14. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Norbert "Hollow" Viking of the Concord (@nordmann_i_viking). The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

The medic cut the last bandage off Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to Q-F14 the same hour. Grey Mill has been won. Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch. Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby asked to leave the signallers and serve as a sniper. The sergeant looked at him for a long time, then signed the paper without a word.

Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby counted the stitches in a darned sock while waiting for orders. Whoever fixed it had used three colors of wool. A letter from home reached Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby before dusk. Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby read it twice and slept a little easier.
A round came through a gap in the sandbags at Q-F14 and grazed Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Silas Mcgrail of the Concord (@patrick.t.mcgrail).
Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby's bandage soaked through twice in one night. The medic called the bearers before morning.
Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to Q-F14.
A lice inspection interrupted a heated argument about politics. Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby pointed out that at least one enemy had been positively identified.
Bastian "Button" Kibtenkibby offered a length of string for a better place near the stove. The offer was refused with surprising dignity.
Bastian was reaching for a canteen at Q-F14 when a round tore the strap in two. It also tore a line across his hand. Shot by Karel Servantofgod of the Concord (@james_servantofgod).
kjwthe1: Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe, a choir singer from Saint-Lune, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in S-R18. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-R18 and grazed Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Leopold Staryfins of the Hegemony (@staryfins). From Blackwater Canal the Hegemony guns have a clear view. Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe wrote to a younger sister who sends drawings that night and said only: 'We will take it back.'

The medic cut the last bandage off Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe's arm and threw it in the stove. He went back to S-R18 the same hour. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe wrote a song about Calvary Farm. Roland Stickus wrote a second verse. The squad has banned the third.
The order came down the line: anything that moves. Something moved. Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe fired, and Oskar Mccarter was grazed.
Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe fired short bursts at the gap in the enemy wire, the way the sergeant taught. Pavel "Crow" Scm was badly wounded trying to cross it.

A bullet hit Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe in the neck at S-R18. The medic kept two fingers pressed on the wound all the way down the trench. Shot by Roland Lovelightnin of the Hegemony (@i_lovelightning420). Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe fired one burst and pulled the gun down before the reply came. The reply hit empty sandbags. Benedikt "Ash" Iamthreatnot did not get to reply at all, grazed. Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe was killed on watch at S-R18. The men found his rifle still resting on the parapet, aimed at the spot the shot came from. Shot by Roland Lovelightnin of the Hegemony (@i_lovelightning420).
Ulrich Kjwthe arrived carrying the family name of Anselm "Mole" Kjwthe. The corporal asked how to pronounce his first name, and waited for the answer.
Ulrich Kjwthe cleaned the gun for the fourth time today. The gun is the only thing in the trench that is kept dry.
Ulrich Kjwthe had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any.
Dawn watch. Ulrich put a round across no man's land and the enemy line went quiet: Rafael Lm, badly wounded.
marcelofernando_32: Clement Marceloferna, a schoolteacher from Belmonte, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in R-C14. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Clement Marceloferna stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Clement Marceloferna and Jonas Mira carved a chessboard into an ammunition box. The pieces are bullets, buttons and one very patient beetle. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Clement Marceloferna answered to number 690. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Clement Marceloferna watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.

The barrage caught Clement Marceloferna in the open at R-C14. The medic tied two tourniquets and shouted for a bed. Clement Marceloferna died at R-C14 under a direct hit. A medic who saw it says it was over in a moment.
The papers connected Dorian Marceloferna to Clement Marceloferna. The men took longer to learn Dorian Marceloferna's own habits, but they made the effort.
A tin cup glinted on the enemy parapet. Dorian Marceloferna aimed just below it. Quentin Allistofeari was grazed.
A borrowed pencil wore down while Dorian Marceloferna was writing home. The last line is twice as large as the first.
Casimir Iii fixed the strap on Dorian Marceloferna's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Dorian Marceloferna's bunk. He has named it Margarethe.
A bullet found Dorian Marceloferna at R-C14, high in the shoulder. He went down hard and stayed down. Shot by Florian Joshbanaka of the Hegemony (@joshbanaka).
Dorian spent a week on a stretcher in the corridor of the aid post. Today he stood up, held the wall, and walked out to R-C14.
nathangrundmeier: By the time Arno Nathangrundm reached S-R18, the war was 9 days old and had its own habits. He learned the first one within the hour: keep your head down.

A bullet went through Arno Nathangrundm's upper arm at S-R18 and broke the bone. He held the arm across his chest and walked half the way back before his legs gave out. Shot by Severin "Crow" Boy of the Hegemony (@st0nk_boy). Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Arno Nathangrundm stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Fever took hold of Arno Nathangrundm overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers. A man in the hospital dugout died before dawn, and his bed went to Arno Nathangrundm. Nobody pretends that is not how it works. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached S-R18 with the rations. Arno Nathangrundm ate while listening to the revised orders.
Arno Nathangrundm's fever broke in the night. The orderly checked the chart twice and smiled for the first time in a week.
Every bed was taken and every medic was busy. Arno Nathangrundm died waiting. The men at S-R18 have not stopped talking about it.
Bram Nathangrundm had heard about Arno Nathangrundm's courage. At S-R18, he also heard about the snoring, the cards and the terrible handwriting.
The cook asked for an honest opinion of the stew. Bram Nathangrundm asked if second helpings depended on the answer.

Bram Nathangrundm was hit in the knee while crossing a low part of the trench at S-R18. He will walk again, the medic thinks, but not soon. Shot by Ivo "Saint" Klaymore of the Hegemony (@klaymore817). Bram Nathangrundm did not want to shoot today. Then the enemy shot first, and Bram Nathangrundm fired back. Bram "Saint" Sumtingwong was badly wounded.
Bram Nathangrundm waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Bram Nathangrundm no longer needed it.
Another member of the House of Nathangrundm reached the line: Walter "Smokes" Nathangrundm. He asked where Bram Nathangrundm had slept, then chose a different corner.
Walter "Smokes" Nathangrundm fixed the strap on Ulrich Kjwthe's pack. The price was a biscuit and a promise to stop mentioning the haircut.
Walter read a psalm aloud at S-R18 while the guns were quiet. It was the only quiet hour of the week.
nguyen_houtarou: Severin Houtarou stepped off the supply cart at V-F12 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name. The sergeant read out the order: Grey Mill has fallen, hold the line. Severin Houtarou looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Severin Houtarou and Silas "Tin" Roman share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship. A letter from home reached Severin Houtarou before dusk. Severin Houtarou read it twice and slept a little easier.

Listening post, three in the morning. Severin Houtarou heard boots, then whispering, then nothing. Just a fox, the corporal said. He did not sleep afterwards. A letter from home reached Severin Houtarou before dusk. Severin Houtarou read it twice and slept a little easier.

Severin Houtarou crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at V-F12 holds again. A letter from home reached Severin Houtarou before dusk. Severin Houtarou read it twice and slept a little easier.

Severin Houtarou (Concord) watched Dietrich Zzz (Hegemony) drag a wounded man back across no man's land at the Bone Quarry, and held fire until both were gone. A letter from home reached Severin Houtarou before dusk. Severin Houtarou read it twice and slept a little easier.

No rifles, only shovels and knives. Severin Houtarou dropped into the Hegemony trench by a dugout door and met Konrad Alexandernym coming out. It was over in seconds. (@alexandernymannn) The letter for Severin Houtarou was mostly about the weather at home. Severin Houtarou read that part twice too.

Severin Houtarou made a list of things to buy on leave. It started with socks and ended with a meal nobody could call a ration. A letter reached Severin Houtarou in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.
Severin censored the men's letters tonight. He crossed out the place names and left in all the love.
owowaaaaaa: The draft reached R-C11 on Day 9. Wendel Owowaaaaaa was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.
The Hegemony hold Blackwater Canal now, and they can see straight into R-C11. Wendel Owowaaaaaa has learned to walk bent double.

Wendel Owowaaaaaa turned a year older today. The whole squad sang for him, badly, and the cook found a candle. The clerk counted the names twice. Wendel Owowaaaaaa is number 673 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. News of the loss of Grey Mill reached R-C11 with the rations. Wendel Owowaaaaaa ate while listening to the revised orders.
The last of the jam was shared by scraping it onto a biscuit. Wendel Owowaaaaaa approved the method.
Wendel Owowaaaaaa tried to remember the sound of the church bell in Varenne. Every version sounded like the ration bell.
A bullet bounced off the trench wall and caught Wendel Owowaaaaaa across the shin at R-C11. It bled a lot and meant very little. Shot by Benedikt Jewnipers of the Hegemony (@jewnipers).
Wendel Owowaaaaaa rejoined the squad at R-C11. Someone had written his name on the wall with 'still alive' under it. He left it there.
Wendel Owowaaaaaa fired at the muzzle flash across the wire before it faded. Teodor Casualkriegs was grazed, and that rifle did not fire again tonight.
Wendel Owowaaaaaa found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning.
Wendel and Ulrich "Parson" Monster tried to invent a new card game. The rules only made sense once they stopped betting tobacco.
ryder_miller11: "You're late," said the corporal when Cyril Miller arrived on Day 4. "Everyone's late. Get a spade."

Cyril Miller found a flower growing out of a sandbag. He did not tell anyone. He checks on it every morning. A letter from home found Cyril Miller before the night shift. Cyril Miller folded it small and kept it close.

A round came through a gap in the sandbags at S-F20 and grazed Cyril Miller's arm. Two inches, the sergeant said. Shot by Florian Monkey of the Concord (@autistic_monkey3). A letter from home found Cyril Miller before the night shift. Cyril Miller folded it small and kept it close. The Hegemony flag went up over Hill 304. Cyril Miller did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
Fever took hold of Cyril Miller overnight. The medics changed the dressing twice and then called for the bearers.
There was never a bed for Cyril Miller, so the medics brought the hospital to him. Three days on a stretcher, and he walked back to S-F20 on his own feet.

Cyril Miller dreamt he was back in Rosenau, working as a tram conductor. He woke up and said nothing all morning. A letter from home found Cyril Miller before the night shift. Cyril Miller folded it small and kept it close.

Cyril Miller was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Hugo Kitty was badly wounded. A letter from home found Cyril Miller before the night shift. Cyril Miller folded it small and kept it close.

At S-F20 a shape dropped into the trench out of the night. Cyril Miller turned around and took a shovel blow. Quentin Tomishidk of the Concord was already gone. Raider: Quentin Tomishidk of the Concord (@tomishidk). The raid was quick, the way back was not. Cyril Miller snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Cyril Miller free. The Hegemony took Blackwater Canal, and the orders at S-F20 changed before the cheering ended. Cyril Miller shouldered another load. A letter from home found Cyril Miller before the night shift. Cyril Miller folded it small and kept it close.

Cyril Miller spent the day on a stretcher outside the aid post, waiting for a bed to come free. The bearers brought water twice. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Cyril Miller answered to number 282. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Cyril Miller folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
Cyril Miller waited two nights for a bed. On the third, a bed came free, but Cyril Miller no longer needed it.
Otto "Crow" Miller joined S-F20 under the shadow of Cyril Miller's name. At the first roll call, the corporal used the right one.
Otto "Crow" Miller stood at the parapet at dawn with the rest of S-F20, bayonet fixed, staring into the grey. Nothing came. Nothing came yesterday, either.
Otto "Crow" Miller borrowed a magnifying glass to read cramped handwriting. The urgently needed word turned out to be 'cabbage'.
Otto "Crow" Miller and Quentin "Hollow" Broadshoulde compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.
Otto "Crow" Miller was on watch at S-F20 when the night raid hit. The men found Otto "Crow" Miller at dawn by the dugout door. Killed in the night raid by Nils Guy of the Concord (@hi.its.guy).
Karel Miller came to the front because his cousin Otto "Crow" Miller never came home. He carries a cracked shaving mirror.
Across the wire at Grey Mill, Zeno "Hollow" Raven of the Concord held up a sign: 'How is your coffee?' Karel Miller of the Hegemony held up a sign back: 'Worse than yours.'
During a lull at Grey Mill, Teodor Mrpickypants called across from the Concord line. Karel Miller answered from the Hegemony side with a perfect imitation of an officer. Both trenches went quiet.
saf3inyoursk1n: Jonas Inyoursk, a stonemason from Rosenau, was sent forward on Day 9 to fill a gap in R-R6. The gap had a name once. Nobody says it.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Jonas Inyoursk kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Machine-gun fire swept R-R6. Jonas Inyoursk took a round through the side and was carried back, grey in the face and very quiet. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte). The bearers reached Jonas Inyoursk at R-R6 too late. One shot, and it was over. Shot by Benedikt Ngaihte of the Hegemony (@mng.ngaihte).

A letter came with Konrad Inyoursk: "I am Jonas Inyoursk's brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Konrad Inyoursk answered to number 886. After the loss of Grey Mill, Konrad Inyoursk helped stack spare sandbags at R-R6. Nobody asked when they would be needed.
Someone asked Konrad Inyoursk to wake them in ten minutes. He had no watch, so he counted slowly and woke them at what felt like ten.
Konrad Inyoursk had been watching the same gap for an hour. When Anselm "Owl" Shadowizard crossed it, Konrad Inyoursk fired. Anselm "Owl" Shadowizard was grazed.
Konrad Inyoursk lost a boot in the trench. Yann "Ghost" Qhmullaney found it, stuffed it with dry socks, and gave it back without a word.
The whole squad at R-R6 fired five rounds rapid. The squad agrees it was Konrad Inyoursk's bullet that found Gideon Bao, grazed.
Konrad Inyoursk watched a woman sweep her doorstep. He had forgotten that dirt could be removed permanently from anywhere.
The sergeant at R-R6 called out a range and a spot. Konrad Inyoursk was the only one who hit it. Yann "Saint" Deerbxnes was grazed.

Across from R-R6, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Konrad saw it. Severin Forn was grazed. Konrad took a bullet in the side at R-R6. His friends laid him on a door and walked very carefully. Shot by Marek Hayden of the Hegemony (@hayden.dt).
senkoo_sann0: Cyril "Mud" Sann unpacked a book with the last pages torn out at R-S8. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was.
Cyril "Mud" Sann's spoon vanished during supper. He scratched a mark into a replacement and began keeping a closer eye on the washing bucket.
A story about a goat passed through three dugouts and reached Cyril "Mud" Sann as a story about a general. The ending was the same.
A second spoon disappeared. Cyril "Mud" Sann searched the washing area and found a gap behind the board where everyone left cutlery to dry.
Otto Commanderchr and Cyril "Mud" Sann share one pair of good gloves on watch, one glove each. It is not practical. It is friendship.
The Hegemony won Blackwater Canal. In R-S8, Cyril "Mud" Sann listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.

Cyril "Mud" Sann lifted the board. The gap contained seven spoons, a button and a pencil people had blamed the quartermaster for losing. Cyril "Mud" Sann got a narrow grey ribbon today, the ribbon of the First Thousand. Number 411. The men who came later will ask about it. The report confirmed that the Hegemony held Grey Mill. Cyril "Mud" Sann read the last line twice, looking for something the first reading had missed.
The recovered spoons were laid out for collection. Cyril "Mud" Sann took the original and repaired the gap before the next meal.
An empty jam tin became Cyril "Mud" Sann's cup. The first drink still tasted of strawberries. He took small sips.
The enemy post had been quiet all morning. Cyril "Mud" Sann waited for that to change. When it did, Severin Ali was grazed.
A periscope poked up from the enemy line. Cyril "Mud" Sann shot it to pieces, and the man holding it, Quentin "Tin" Ahmadhcj, was badly wounded.
A sneeze blew dust off the shelf above Cyril "Mud" Sann. This caused another sneeze and a discussion about moving the shelf.
Across from R-S8, an enemy soldier stood up to stretch. Cyril "Mud" Sann saw it. Dorian Austintress was badly wounded.
Fresh from training, Cyril still aims the way the instructor said. Today it worked: Konrad Sebs, badly wounded.
shermantank20000: Day 11: Casimir Shermantank reached V-F8 with a full packet of cigarettes. Learning everyone's name proved remarkably easy. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Casimir Shermantank wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
Casimir Shermantank and Isidor Nult found a cat in the ruins at Lantern Hill and argued for an hour about its name. The cat settled it by sleeping on Isidor.
Casimir Shermantank and Felix Type compared drawings of home. Both drawings included a kitchen table larger than the house.

A sniper's bullet hit Casimir Shermantank at V-F8. The medics worked on him in the bottom of the trench and shouted for a stretcher. Shot by Konrad Alexandernym of the Hegemony (@alexandernymannn). Casimir Shermantank stood up to fix a loose sandbag at V-F8. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Konrad Alexandernym of the Hegemony (@alexandernymannn).
Emil Shermantank put a lucky button beside the bunk. Someone who had known Casimir Shermantank helped clear the shelf without saying why.
Emil Shermantank tried to sketch a horse from memory. The dugout agreed it was a very good dog.
A rat has started sitting on the ammunition box next to Emil Shermantank's bunk. He has named it Margarethe.
The bread was divided with a ruler. Emil Shermantank received the smallest piece and the job of looking after the ruler.

Emil took a bullet in the side at V-F8. His friends laid him on a door and walked very carefully. Shot by Leopold Alexandernym of the Hegemony (@alexandernymannn). A single bullet found Emil at V-F8. He dropped without a word, and the rifle slid down beside him.
A letter came with Konrad Shermantank: "I am Emil Shermantank's older brother. I have come to finish what he started." Nobody had the heart to tell him it never finishes.
tiberius.bon: Jonas Bon walked into S-R9 on Day 9 and asked where the war was. A shell answered before anyone else could.
Word came down the line: Blackwater Canal is ours. Jonas Bon shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.

Jonas Bon fired at the enemy dawn watch from S-R9. Dietrich Caydan was grazed, and the enemy line spent the morning with its heads down. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Jonas Bon is number 996. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Jonas Bon left the work of a rifleman to become a sapper. Someone from the old section came over to see how it was going. The Hegemony secured Grey Mill. Jonas Bon helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly.

Jonas Bon dreamt he was back in Stoneyford, working as a coal miner. He woke up and said nothing all morning. Mail came up the line with a letter for Jonas Bon. Jonas Bon read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.
Jonas Bon carved his initials into the trench wall next to a hundred others. Some of them are only half finished.

A bullet hit the sandbag next to Jonas Bon's ear at S-R9 and sprayed his face with grit and blood. A scratch, the medic said, and a lucky one. Shot by Jonas Themimicches of the Concord (@themimicchest).
The medics cleaned Jonas Bon's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-R9.
Jonas Bon spent the night underground, listening. Somewhere beneath the Bone Quarry someone else was digging too.
A pump handle snapped off in Jonas Bon's hands. He fixed it while the water rose around his ankles.
Jonas dug a small ditch around the aid post to carry water away. The medic thanked him with a boiled egg.
viti_w02: At the depot, Walter "Crow" Viti had practised answering to his name. At Q-F11, the first person to call it only wanted help with a crate.

Walter "Crow" Viti went over with the raiders and dropped into the Concord trench. Benedikt Johnson was hit hard before the whistle called everyone back. (@najeb_johnson) Walter "Crow" Viti came back from the raid with mud to the eyebrows and an enemy helmet as a souvenir. Walter "Crow" Viti felt a hard tug at his hip at Q-F11. The bullet had cut through his belt and the skin under it. He tied the belt back together with string. Shot by Marek Zenga of the Concord (@tyler.zenga). Blackwater Canal has been won. Walter "Crow" Viti listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch. A letter from home reached Walter "Crow" Viti before dusk. Walter "Crow" Viti read it twice and slept a little easier.

A single shot from across the wire hit Walter "Crow" Viti in the thigh at Q-F11. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue of the Concord (@grebegue). Walter "Crow" Viti was hit at Q-F11 and died before the medic arrived. The squad has kept his place on the fire step empty. Shot by Jonas "Whistle" Grebegue of the Concord (@grebegue).

Leopold "Owl" Viti asked about Walter "Crow" Viti on arriving at Q-F11. The first story concerned a stolen breakfast. He asked for another. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Leopold "Owl" Viti during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.

Leopold "Owl" Viti raised his head for a heartbeat too long at Q-F11. The bullet only grazed him. He will not do it again. Shot by Gustav "Tin" Ratpick of the Concord (@ratpick45). A letter from home reached Leopold "Owl" Viti before dusk. Leopold "Owl" Viti read it twice and slept a little easier. Leopold "Owl" Viti bought War Bonds for the front. The quartermaster pinned the ribbon on personally: 'The front remembers who kept it fed.' Leopold "Owl" Viti was invited to the Officers' Mess for keeping the front supplied. The colonel poured a real coffee and raised his cup: 'The front does not forget its friends.' A dachshund wandered in from no man's land at dawn, wet and hungry. It chose Leopold "Owl" Viti. Leopold "Owl" Viti gave it a name: Brownie.

Leopold "Owl" Viti came back to the squad today. The men had kept his spot on the fire step and his spoon. A letter from home reached Leopold "Owl" Viti before dusk. Leopold "Owl" Viti read it twice and slept a little easier.

Leopold "Owl" Viti crawled out with the wiring party. When a flare went up, he lay still and counted to ten. The wire at Q-F11 holds again. A letter from home reached Leopold "Owl" Viti before dusk. Leopold "Owl" Viti read it twice and slept a little easier.

Leopold "Owl" Viti had a letter from home. He read it four times and then once more out loud, for the men who never get any. Brownie growled at the dark long before anyone heard a sound. Leopold "Owl" Viti woke the post. The dog was right.

The raiders came over the parapet in the dark. Leopold "Owl" Viti was hit hard in the fight at Q-F11 before anyone could fire. The raider was Bastian Deionmurillo of the Concord. Raider: Bastian Deionmurillo of the Concord (@deionmurillo). Leopold "Owl" Viti asked the bearers for water and then for his mother. He died before either came.

Another member of the House of Viti reached the line: Rafael Viti. He asked where Leopold "Owl" Viti had slept, then chose a different corner. Brownie did not eat for two days after Leopold "Owl" Viti fell. On the third day it walked up to Rafael Viti and sat down. That was that.

A bullet hit Rafael Viti in the back as he turned to pass ammunition along at Q-F11. He went down on the duckboards and the men shouted for the bearers. Shot by Pavel Olivas of the Concord (@joseph.olivas.3762). There was no bed for Rafael Viti. He lay on a stretcher outside, wrapped in a coat, listening to the guns.

Rafael returned to Q-F11 thinner and paler, with a wound that closed without a single night in a bed. The medics count it as one of theirs. Brownie barked at a flare and then looked very proud of itself. Rafael had to hold its mouth shut. A letter reached Rafael in the rain. The ink ran a little, but every word that mattered was still there.
xanny.j530: Wendel "Crow" Xanny stepped off the supply cart at P-F12 and stood very still, listening to the guns as if they were saying his name.

Wendel "Crow" Xanny borrowed a serial novel from a newspaper bundle. The instalment ends with a locked door and a pistol shot. The next issue is missing. Word came down the line: Grey Mill is ours. Wendel "Crow" Xanny shook hands with a corporal he had never spoken to. Today, everyone was a friend.
Wendel "Crow" Xanny has asked three carrying parties for the next instalment. So far, the search has produced racing results and an advertisement for boots.
Wendel "Crow" Xanny wrote a letter home. He wrote about the weather. He did not write about the rats.
The aid post ran out of morphine at four. Wendel "Crow" Xanny held a boy's hand until six. Then he went back for the next one.

A bullet struck Wendel "Crow" Xanny below the ribs at P-F12. He kept asking whether the post was still manned until the bearers took him away. Shot by Isidor Gallianrecon of the Concord (@gallianrecon).
Wendel "Crow" Xanny drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer.
Wendel "Crow" Xanny did not last the night outside the full aid post. The bearers who carried him in carried him out again at dawn.
Valentin "Whistle" Xanny came to the front because his father Wendel "Crow" Xanny never came home. He carries a child's drawing of a horse.
Valentin won a week of rum at cards from a lance corporal in P-F12. The lance corporal wants a rematch.
